title: Koenigsegg Jesko in the Night Studio Above the City
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
description:
Welcome to the Night Studio Above the City, where a vibrant giallo yellow Koenigsegg Jesko rests quietly in the calm shadows. Beyond the wide glass, an endless city glitters far below while the room screens glow low around you. There is no music tonight, just two hours of deep brown noise washing through the peaceful air. Settle in and let the sound hold you, whether you are drifting off to sleep or finding your focus.

No music. No talking. No sudden sounds. Seamless from start to finish, so nothing wakes you up.

PARKED FM | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
